notes:
What's new in 0.1.49:
• Pick quality, audio language and subtitles in the player, and search subtitles online.
• Music: point Settings at a folder and play your albums anywhere, with lyrics.
• Photos, and your phone can back its camera up to this computer.
• Playlists, including smart ones that fill themselves in.
• Parental controls for each person, and sharing your library with another household.
• A Dashboard showing who's watching, from where, and how your server is doing.
